item.title: Using AI during a penetration test
item.description: An AI tool reads an API specification and suggests a possible access-control problem. That might be a useful lead. Before it belongs in a penetration test report, someone needs to establish whether the endpoint exists in the tested version, whether the suspected behaviour is reachable, and what actually happens when it is tested.

item.title: Testing an AI assistant inside a Jira app
item.description: Imagine an assistant that summarises a Jira project and offers to create follow-up tasks. In a demo, it reads the issues, writes a helpful summary, and creates a task when asked. Everything appears to work.
